headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 1, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball. Spencer Jones led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in a closely contested game, while the Philadelphia Phillies suffered a 4-6 loss to the Baltimore Orioles.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Mike Paredes being transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list by the Minnesota Twins due to a left oblique strain. Other injured players include Brock Stewart (Los Angeles Dodgers), Matt Vierling (Detroit Tigers), J.P. Crawford (Seattle Mariners), Cionel Pérez (New York Mets), Shane McClanahan (Tampa Bay Rays), Gavin Hollowell (Chicago Cubs), and Cole Sands (Minnesota Twins).

The Milwaukee Brewers bolstered their catching depth with the acquisition of catcher Bo Naylor in a trade with the Cleveland Guardians. The Brewers also made a trade with the Baltimore Orioles, acquiring Jhomnardo Reyes in exchange for Dean Kremer. Additionally, the Minnesota Twins acquired A.J. Minter from the New York Mets in a trade, while the Detroit Tigers traded catcher Jake Rogers to the Orioles in exchange for Zane Barnhart.

top_news.title: **Yankees Shut Out Cubs 2-0**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball. Spencer Jones led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past Pirates in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in a closely contested game. Sal Stewart led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a 4-6 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, unable to overcome a strong Orioles offense. Pete Alonso led the Phillies with 2 hits, including a home run, while Andrew Painter pitched 6 strong innings, striking out 6 batters.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dropped a 3-1 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Luis Urías leading the offense with a single, 2 RBI, and 1 AB. Jeff Hoffman earned the win for the Blue Jays, while Louis Varland secured the save.

top_news.title: **Twins RHP Mike Paredes Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Minnesota Twins right-handed pitcher Mike Paredes has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left oblique strain.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Catching Depth with Trade Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have acquired catcher Bo Naylor in a trade with the Cleveland Guardians. Naylor joins the Brewers' roster, adding to their catching depth.
